gloss: to order; to send away for; to have something delivered

definitions.gloss: to order; to send away for; to have something delivered
definitions.explanation: to request that something be sent from a distant location, often specialty food or goods not available locally

examples.japanese: ⟦{北海道|ほっかいどう}→北海道：11010_hokkaidou⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧カニ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{取|と}り{寄|よ}せた。
⟦ネット→ネット：05279_netto⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦お{取|と}り{寄|よ}せ→お取り寄せ：09827_otoriyose⟧⟦スイーツ→スイーツ：27370_suiitsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{注文|ちゅうもん}した→注文する：21390_chuumon⟧。
examples.english: I ordered specialty sweets for delivery online.

examples.japanese: ⟦{地方|ちほう}→地方：02369_chihou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{名産品|めいさんひん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{取|と}り{寄|よ}せて、⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{楽|たの}しむ→楽しむ：01203_tanoshimu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{趣味|しゅみ}→趣味：00889_shumi⟧です。
examples.english: My hobby is ordering regional specialties and enjoying them with my family.

notes:
Specifically implies ordering from a distant or special source rather than buying at a local store. Very commonly used for regional specialty foods (⟦お{取|と}り{寄|よ}せ→お取り寄せ：09827_otoriyose⟧⟦グルメ→グルメ：10845_gurume⟧). The honorific prefix お is frequently attached in commercial contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦お{取|と}り{寄|よ}せ→お取り寄せ：09827_otoriyose⟧⟦グルメ→グルメ：10845_gurume⟧: mail-order gourmet food
- ⟦{産地|さんち}→産地：04031_sanchi⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{取|と}り{寄|よ}せる: order directly from the production area
- ⟦ネット→ネット：05279_netto⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{取|と}り{寄|よ}せる: order online for delivery
- {取|と}り{寄|よ}せ⟦{品|ひん}→品：03712_hin⟧: items ordered from elsewhere

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{注文|ちゅうもん}する→注文する：21390_chuumon⟧: to order — general ordering, including at restaurants; {取|と}り{寄|よ}せる specifically implies ordering from a distant source
- ⟦{通販|つうはん}→通販：17464_tsuuhan⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{買|か}う→買う：00489_kau⟧: to buy via mail order — more neutral; {取|と}り{寄|よ}せる carries a nuance of specialty or luxury

CULTURAL NOTE:
⟦お{取|と}り{寄|よ}せ→お取り寄せ：09827_otoriyose⟧ culture is very popular in Japan, where people order famous local specialties (⟦{名物|めいぶつ}→名物：05591_meibutsu⟧) from other regions. Department store catalogs and online services specialize in this.
